title: CS2 event guide — Thunderpick World Championship 2026 Finals
intro: Verified event information for the Counter-Strike 2 Thunderpick World Championship 2026 Finals: the confirmed venue and street address, the spectator ticketing page, daily check-in and games times, opening-day and playoff match clocks in Malta time, the team field, format and prize pool, and the official online broadcast. This page exists because the event is the reason for the trip and because the earlier planning position could not confirm spectator access at all. Every entry names what its source does and does not establish; schedule details can still change, so re-check the organiser and ticketing pages before travelling.

records.name: BLAST Arena Studios Malta — confirmed venue and street address
records.area: Ħ'Attard / Ta' Qali — MFCC National Stadium complex
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, Malta. The ticketing page's own map links pin the venue at latitude 35.8957343, longitude 14.4168839.
records.hours: Event run Wednesday 14 October – Sunday 18 October 2026. The ticketing page header lists the run as 9:30 AM–10 PM; per-day check-in and games times are in the 'Daily check-in and games times' entry.
records.price range: Entry is by event ticket — see the 'Spectator tickets' entry. No separate venue price list was rendered in the page text checked.
records.description: The venue for the Counter-Strike 2 Thunderpick World Championship 2026 Finals is now confirmed by the event's own ticketing page: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, at the MFCC South Gate National Stadium in Attard (ATD 4000). This resolves the earlier 'venue-area context only' limitation — the address, the map pin and the event dates all come from the ticketing listing for this specific event, not from a different BLAST event. The studio sits inside the Ta' Qali National Stadium complex, which is the same inland location the earlier BLAST guides pointed to. Use the pin coordinates for a taxi or journey-planner query rather than typing the town name alone.
records.notes: Ticketing page checked 11 Oct 2026; it is organised by Hotspawn, which Thunderpick's own 16 Sept release names as the tournament's Presenting Partner: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/thunderpick-world-championship-2026-reveals-eight-team-field-for-1-million-malta-finals-302880720.html . The same address is published for other BLAST Arena Studios Malta events by EventWorks: https://eventworks.mt/blast-slam-vi and by a venue directory listing that also gives the 35.8957343, 14.4168839 pin: https://www.visitmalta.co.uk/business-directory/entertainment-venues-malta/blast-arena-studios-malta . BLAST's own attendee guide for a separate July 2026 event gives the complex as 'Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre Ta Qali, ATD 4000 Ħ'Attard': https://blast.tv/cs/news/malta-fan-guide . Liquipedia lists the venue as BLAST Arena Studios, Attard: https://liquipedia.net/counterstrike/Thunderpick/World_Championship/2026 . The exact attendee gate, entrance door and bag/security rules for THIS event were not rendered in the page text checked; the Eventbrite FAQ question titles exist but their answers did not render, so do not assume another BLAST event's entrance instructions apply.

records.name: Spectator tickets — in-person registration, ages 18+
records.area: Ħ'Attard / Ta' Qali — MFCC National Stadium complex
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, Malta
records.hours: Registration covers the event run Wednesday 14 – Sunday 18 October 2026. The ticketing page flags 'Sales end soon'.
records.price range: Free on the event's own listing: its ticket block displays 'Free' with a 'Reserve a spot' action, under a 'Sales end soon' notice. No ticket-tier or fee table rendered in the text read, and no reservation is held by this project — confirm the final total (including any booking fee) at checkout.
records.description: In-person spectator attendance is possible: the event has a live ticketing/registration page, listed as 'Hotspawn present the Thunderpick World Championships 2026', running Wednesday 14 to Sunday 18 October at BLAST Arena Studios Malta. The page's own highlights state 'In person' and 'ages 18+', so bring photo ID and expect an age check. HLTV reported on 2 October that tickets for the event are available for free and linked to this page. This is a significant change from the earlier planning position, which could not confirm any spectator access at all.
records.notes: The registration page and its 'In person' / 'ages 18+' highlights were read directly on 11 Oct 2026. The free-of-charge claim comes from HLTV's talent article, which states 'Tickets for the event are available for free by going here' and links to this exact Eventbrite page: https://www.hltv.org/news/45615/thunderpick-world-championship-talent-revealed . A discount code form of the same link (discount=MALTAESPORTS) was also reachable and showed the same content. Whether one ticket is valid for all five days, whether it is scanned daily, whether it is transferable, and whether parking is available are all listed as FAQ question titles on the page but their answers did not render in the text checked — these stay open questions and must be read on the page itself or asked of the organiser. Availability is not guaranteed: the page shows a 'Sales end soon' notice and capacity for a broadcast studio is limited. No ticket was purchased or held by this project. Re-read 11 October 2026: the page displays a 'Sales end soon' banner and its own event card shows 'Free' with the dates Oct 14–18 and a 'Reserve a spot' action, which supports — but does not replace — the HLTV free-ticket statement above. The nine FAQ question titles rendered (parking, 18+ restriction, one-ticket-for-all-days, daily scanning, daily times, schedule changes, food and drink, toilets, transferability) while none of their answers did, so every one of those remains open. No ticket was purchased, reserved or held by this project.

records.name: Event dates and tournament phases
records.area: Malta — with the traveler's stay 13–19 October 2026
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, Malta
records.hours: Organiser's overall window 12–19 October 2026: Arrival Day 12 October, Media Day 13 October, Group Stage 14–16 October, Playoffs 17–18 October, Departure Day 19 October. The competitive Finals that spectators attend run 14–18 October.
records.description: Two official sources agree on the competitive dates. Thunderpick's own tournament page gives the full 12–19 October programme including non-playing arrival, media and departure days, and its press releases give the Finals as 14–18 October at BLAST Studios Malta. The event's ticketing page independently lists Wednesday 14 to Sunday 18 October. For this trip that means: 13 October is a travel/media day with no public matches, 14–16 October are Group Stage days, 17–18 October are Playoff days, and 19 October is a departure day with no matches. Every match day of the Finals falls inside the 13–19 October hotel stay.
records.notes: Official organiser page re-read 11 Oct 2026. Thunderpick-issued releases confirm the 14–18 October Finals at BLAST Studios Malta: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/thunderpick-world-championship-2026-returns-to-malta-with-1-million-prize-pool-302850221.html (13 Aug 2026) and https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/thunderpick-world-championship-2026-reveals-eight-team-field-for-1-million-malta-finals-302880720.html (16 Sept 2026, datelined TA' QALI, Malta). The ticketing page lists Wed 14 – Sun 18 October: https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/hotspawn-present-the-thunderpick-world-championships-2026-tickets-1988838616841 . The organiser page also names GAM3RS_X as tournament operator and GRID Esports as data partner, and lists the Schengen Area as the visa region. Note the difference between the organiser's 12–19 October production window and the 14–18 October spectator/match window: only 14–18 has published public attendance. Phase dates can still change; the organiser page says to stay tuned for match schedule details.

records.name: Daily check-in and games times (official ticketing agenda)
records.area: Ħ'Attard / Ta' Qali — MFCC National Stadium complex
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, Malta
records.hours: As rendered on the ticketing agenda on 11 October 2026 — Wednesday 14 October: check-in 09:30, games 10:30, day listed 09:30–22:30. Thursday 15 October: check-in 09:30, games 10:30, day listed 09:30–22:30. Friday 16 October: check-in 14:00, games 15:00, day listed 14:00–21:00. Saturday 17 and Sunday 18 October were behind a 'Show all agenda' control and did not render in the text checked.
records.description: These are the times that matter for transport planning. On Wednesday 14 and Thursday 15 October the venue day runs from a 09:30 check-in to a listed 22:30 finish; on Friday 16 October it runs 14:00 to 21:00. Plan to arrive for check-in, not for the first game. The listed 22:30 finish on the two group-stage days is later than the last bus departure recorded from the Ta' Qali Stadium stop, so the return leg on those days needs a taxi, ride-hailing or a pre-arranged lift — see the Transport guide for the comparison and the late-return options.
records.notes: Read directly from the ticketing page's Agenda section on 11 Oct 2026. Three of the five days rendered; the page's overall header lists the run as '9:30 AM-10 PM' and its highlights summarise the total duration as '4 days 12 hours', which does not obviously reconcile with the per-day rows — treat the per-day agenda rows as the more specific evidence and re-check the full agenda on the page. Saturday 17 and Sunday 18 check-in/games times remain unpublished in the text checked and are recorded as an open question. The organiser page separately warns that schedules can change, and the ticketing FAQ includes a 'Can the event schedule change?' question whose answer did not render. Times shown are the venue's local times (Malta, CEST / UTC+2 until 25 October 2026).

records.name: Match start times in Malta time (CEST, UTC+2)
records.area: Ħ'Attard / Ta' Qali — MFCC National Stadium complex
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, Malta
records.hours: Wednesday 14 October, Malta time: 10:30 9z v Aurora (Group A opener); 13:00 Falcons v Ninjas in Pyjamas (Group A opener); 15:30 Legacy v PARIVISION (Group B opener); 18:00 FURIA v BETBOOM (Group B opener). Saturday 17 October: 16:00 Semifinal 1; 19:00 Semifinal 2. Sunday 18 October: 13:30 Third-place decider; 17:00 Grand Final (Best-of-5). Thursday 15 and Friday 16 October carry the remaining group-stage winners/elimination/decider matches; per-match times for those two days were not listed in the sources checked.
records.description: Opening-day and playoff start times, converted to Malta local time. Third-party bracket listings publish these times in US Eastern (EDT, UTC-4); adding six hours gives Malta CEST (UTC+2). That conversion is independently anchored by official evidence: the ticketing agenda states games start at 10:30 on Wednesday 14 October, which is exactly the converted 04:30 EDT first-match time. Two listings also agree with each other after conversion. Treat the opening-day and playoff clocks as good planning estimates for arrival and departure, not as organiser-published guarantees — the organiser's own page still says to stay tuned for match schedule details, and the ticketing FAQ flags that the schedule can change.
records.notes: Per-match times come from third-party bracket listings, not from the organiser: Liquipedia lists 14 October opening matches at 04:30, 07:00, 09:30 and 12:00 EDT, 17 October semifinals at 10:00 and 13:00 EDT, and 18 October third place at 07:30 EDT with the Grand Final at 11:00 EDT: https://liquipedia.net/counterstrike/Thunderpick/World_Championship/2026 . HLTV's match pages carry the same fixtures: https://www.hltv.org/matches/2399386/legacy-vs-parivision-thunderpick-world-championship-2026 and https://www.hltv.org/matches/2399387/furia-vs-betboom-thunderpick-world-championship-2026 , and its event page is https://www.hltv.org/events/8932/thunderpick-world-championship-2026 . Important caveat: HLTV renders clock times in the viewer's own time zone — the same match page showed 15:30 in one view and 09:30 in another — so HLTV times must never be copied as local times without checking the zone. Liquipedia's displayed times were explicitly labelled EDT. Malta is CEST (UTC+2) for the whole trip because EU summer time ends 25 October 2026, so EDT-to-Malta is +6 hours. An earlier project pass removed a Liquipedia-only evening schedule because it had no official anchor; this entry is different because the official ticketing agenda's 10:30 games start on 14 October independently confirms the conversion. A 9 October Thunderpick X post referenced an opening-day schedule image that was not machine-readable: https://x.com/thunderpickco/status/2108604711968317828 .

records.name: Teams, groups, format and prize pool
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, Malta
records.price range: US$1,000,000 total prize pool. The organiser's published split: 1st $500,000; 2nd $250,000; 3rd $100,000; 4th $50,000; 5th–6th $30,000 each; 7th–8th $20,000 each (each placement split 50/50 between club and players).
records.description: Eight teams, two double-elimination (GSL) groups of four, all group matches Best-of-3. The top two from each group advance to a single-elimination playoff with a third-place decider, and the Grand Final is Best-of-5. Thunderpick's 16 September release announced the field as Legacy (#3), Falcons (#4), FURIA (#8), BETBOOM (#9), 9z (#10), Aurora (#12), PARIVISION (#17) and Virtus.pro (#30), with FURIA the defending champions. That field has since changed: Virtus.pro withdrew on 9 October for visa and health reasons and Ninjas in Pyjamas took the slot. Opening-day groupings put Falcons, NIP, 9z and Aurora in Group A and Legacy, PARIVISION, FURIA and BETBOOM in Group B.
records.notes: Format and prize distribution read from the organiser's own page on 11 Oct 2026: https://world-championship.thunderpick.io/2026-finals/ . The eight-team field and Valve ranking positions come from the Thunderpick-issued 16 Sept 2026 release used as this record's primary source; that release still names Virtus.pro, so it is now partly superseded. The withdrawal and replacement are reported by third-party esports media and are not yet reflected on the organiser pages checked: HLTV, 9 Oct 2026 — https://www.hltv.org/news/45688/thunderpick-world-championship-matchups-announced-with-virtuspro-replaced-by-nip (also gives the opening matchups and the Group A / Group B split); Hotspawn — https://www.hotspawn.com/counter-strike/news/nip-replace-virtus-pro-at-thunderpick-world-championship-2026 ; Liquipedia's participant note records 'October 9th - Virtus.pro withdraw from the event due to health and visa issues; they are replaced by Ninjas in Pyjamas': https://liquipedia.net/counterstrike/Thunderpick/World_Championship/2026 . The Eventbrite lineup images showed Legacy, Falcons, FURIA, Betboom, 9z and Aurora with a 'View all' control, so the ticketing page did not confirm the full eight in the text checked. Rosters and the bracket can still change; re-check before travelling.

records.name: Official broadcast talent and live streams (not radio)
records.area: Online — worldwide streams; no Malta radio carriage confirmed
records.hours: All matches across the 14–18 October 2026 Finals are announced for live broadcast.
records.price range: Free-to-air online streams; no paywall was stated in the sources checked. Data costs or a venue/hotel Wi-Fi dependency apply.
records.description: If attending in person is not possible on a given day — or for the two days whose agenda times were not published — the organiser states that all matches are broadcast live on Thunderpick's Twitch, Kick and YouTube channels. The announced on-air team is casters Chad 'SPUNJ' Burchill, Alex 'Machine' Richardson, Hugo Byron and Harry 'JustHarry' Russell; desk hosts Tres 'stunna' Saranthus and Sam 'Tech Girl' Wright; analysts Sudhen 'Bleh' Wahengbam, Janko 'YNk' Paunović, Teodor 'Tedd' Borisov and Jason 'moses' O'Toole; sideline reporter Anastasija 'Heccu' Tolmačeva; and stage host James 'BanKs' Banks. This is an internet stream, not a radio broadcast — it is recorded here so the Sports radio page is not confused by it, and because streaming is the fallback if a match day is missed at the venue.
records.notes: Thunderpick-issued 16 Sept 2026 release names the casters, desk hosts, analysts, sideline reporter and stage host and states 'All matches will be broadcast live on Thunderpick's Twitch, Kick and YouTube', linking https://twitch.tv/thunderpicktv , https://kick.com/thunderpick and https://www.youtube.com/@thunderpickesports . The same talent list was independently reported by HLTV on 2 Oct 2026: https://www.hltv.org/news/45615/thunderpick-world-championship-talent-revealed . Stream availability, geo-blocking and platform terms were not tested from Malta and no Malta radio frequency carrying the event was found — see the Sports radio page, which keeps radio carriage strictly separate. Streaming depends on connectivity: check the hotel Wi-Fi and mobile data allowance, covered in the Everyday guide.

records.name: On-site practicalities — age limit, ID and unanswered venue questions
records.area: Ħ'Attard / Ta' Qali — MFCC National Stadium complex
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, Malta
records.hours: Applies on each event day, 14–18 October 2026, during the published check-in and games windows.
records.price range: Not published in the page text checked — on-site food, drink and parking costs are unknown.
records.description: The ticketing page states the event is 'In person' and restricted to 'ages 18+', so every attendee needs to be 18 or over and should carry government-issued photo ID (a US passport is the natural choice for this traveler). Beyond that, the page lists FAQ questions about parking, whether one ticket covers every day, whether tickets are scanned daily, the daily check-in and event times, whether the schedule can change, whether food and drink are available on site, toilet availability and ticket transfer — but the answers did not render in the text checked. Those remain open, and each one has a practical consequence for the trip, so read them on the page before travelling.
records.notes: The 'ages 18+' and 'In person' highlights and the nine FAQ question titles were read directly on 11 Oct 2026; the FAQ answers are delivered by client-side script and were not present in the extracted text. Do not infer an answer from another BLAST event's attendee guide — BLAST's guide for a separate July 2026 event published its own doors times and prohibited-items list, which are not transferable: https://blast.tv/cs/news/malta-fan-guide . Practical consequences flagged as open questions in docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md: whether one ticket covers all five days (affects whether to re-register), whether parking exists (affects the car-hire decision), and whether food and drink are sold on site (affects the event-day food budget and whether to eat in Ta' Qali or Attard beforehand). Nearby food options are listed in the Food & cafés guide, including two entries tagged for the Mdina/Mosta area close to the venue.
